title: Build the validator harness and the budgets rule
acceptance: WHEN `python scripts/validate_skill.py --version` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL print `validate_skill 1.0.0` and exit 0.
WHEN `python scripts/validate_skill.py --list-rules` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL print `budgets` and exit 0.

WHEN `python scripts/validate_skill.py` runs against this repository THE SYSTEM SHALL report zero findings and exit 0, because each document's newline-terminated line count — 496, 422, 82 and 442 — is under its ceiling in `scripts/validator-config.json`.
WHEN an unknown flag is passed THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 2 and SHALL NOT exit 1, so a malformed command can never be mistaken for a failing repository.
WHEN `--rule no-such-rule` is passed THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 2 and print the registered rule names.
WHEN `--config` names a file that does not exist THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 2 with a message beginning `config:`.

title: Add the frontmatter rule
acceptance: WHEN the `frontmatter` rule runs against this repository THE SYSTEM SHALL report zero findings, because `SKILL.md` carries `name`, `version` and `description` with `name` equal to the `expected_name` in `scripts/validator-config.json`.
WHEN the frontmatter block is missing its closing delimiter THE SYSTEM SHALL report exactly one finding at line 1.
WHEN a required key is absent THE SYSTEM SHALL report one finding naming that key.
WHEN the version value is not three dot-separated runs of digits THE SYSTEM SHALL report one finding quoting the value found.
WHEN `--list-rules` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL print both `budgets` and `frontmatter`.

title: Add the counts rule
acceptance: WHEN the `counts` rule runs against this repository THE SYSTEM SHALL report zero findings, because every pattern claim equals the number of numbered table rows in `references/patterns.md` and every template claim equals the number of `## Template ` headings in `references/templates.md`.
WHEN a claim states a number that differs from its derived truth THE SYSTEM SHALL report one finding at that claim's line, naming both numbers.
WHEN a historical claim appears below the stop marker configured for that file THE SYSTEM SHALL report nothing for it.
WHEN a configured truth file is missing from the tree THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 2 rather than report a finding.
WHEN the number of rows in `references/patterns.md` changes and every claim is updated to match THE SYSTEM SHALL stay silent without any edit to the rule.

title: Add the zones rule
acceptance: WHEN the `zones` rule runs against this repository THE SYSTEM SHALL report zero findings, because the three zone names in `scripts/validator-config.json` each appear exactly once in `SKILL.md` as a level-two heading, in the listed order.
WHEN a zone heading is absent THE SYSTEM SHALL report one finding naming that zone.
WHEN a zone heading appears twice THE SYSTEM SHALL report one finding carrying the line of the duplicate.
WHEN two zone headings appear in the wrong order THE SYSTEM SHALL report one finding naming both.

title: Add the links rule
acceptance: WHEN the `links` rule runs against this repository THE SYSTEM SHALL report zero findings, because both paths under `references/` that the documents mention exist on disk and every in-file anchor link in `references/templates.md` resolves to a heading in that same file.
WHEN a mentioned path under `references/` does not exist THE SYSTEM SHALL report one finding at the mention's line.
WHEN an in-file anchor names a slug no heading produces THE SYSTEM SHALL report one finding carrying that slug.

WHEN a heading contains an em dash THE SYSTEM SHALL compute the same slug GitHub computes — lowercase, drop every character that is not a word character, whitespace or hyphen, then replace each whitespace run with one hyphen — so a correct table-of-contents entry is not reported.

title: Add the version-sync rule
acceptance: WHEN the `version-sync` rule runs against this repository THE SYSTEM SHALL report zero findings, because the frontmatter version rendered in bold Markdown appears in `README.md`.
WHEN the frontmatter version is bumped and `README.md` is not updated THE SYSTEM SHALL report exactly one finding naming the missing version.
WHEN the frontmatter block is unparseable THE SYSTEM SHALL report nothing here, leaving that failure to the `frontmatter` rule, so one defect produces one finding.

title: Add the encoding rule
acceptance: WHEN the `encoding` rule runs against this repository THE SYSTEM SHALL report zero findings for all four documents.
WHEN a file carries a byte-order mark THE SYSTEM SHALL report one finding for that file.
WHEN a file ends with two or more newlines THE SYSTEM SHALL report one finding for that file.
WHEN a file ends with no newline THE SYSTEM SHALL report one finding for that file.
WHEN a file contains CRLF line endings and `forbid_crlf` is false in `scripts/validator-config.json` THE SYSTEM SHALL report nothing for it.

title: Add --root and the first three negative fixtures
acceptance: WHEN the validator runs with `--root` pointed at the budgets fixture and that fixture's own config THE SYSTEM SHALL report at least one `budgets` finding and exit 1.
WHEN it runs the `zones` rule against that same fixture THE SYSTEM SHALL report zero findings and exit 0, proving the fixture isolates one rule.
WHEN it runs the `frontmatter` rule against the frontmatter fixture THE SYSTEM SHALL report at least one finding and exit 1.
WHEN it runs the `counts` rule against the counts fixture THE SYSTEM SHALL report exactly one finding — the claim above the stop marker, not the historical one below it — and exit 1.
WHEN a plain full run of the repository runs after the fixtures are added THE SYSTEM SHALL still exit 0, because `scripts/tests/fixtures` is listed in `exclude_dirs`.

title: Add the remaining four fixtures and --self-test
acceptance: WHEN `--self-test` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL print one line per fixture directory and exit 0.
WHEN a fixture stops failing its own rule THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 1 naming that fixture and the rule that went silent.
WHEN a fixture fails a rule other than its own THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 1 naming the fixture and the unexpected rule.
WHEN a rule is registered with no fixture directory of the same name THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 1, so a rule added later cannot skip its proof.
WHEN a plain full run of the repository runs afterwards THE SYSTEM SHALL still exit 0.

title: Add the json and github output formats
acceptance: WHEN `--format json` runs on a clean tree THE SYSTEM SHALL print one JSON object whose `findings` is an empty list and whose `exit_code` is 0, and exit 0.
WHEN `--format json` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL emit the five keys `tool`, `repo_root`, `rules_run`, `findings` and `exit_code`, and nothing else on stdout.
WHEN `--format json` runs with a single rule selected THE SYSTEM SHALL list only that rule in `rules_run`.
WHEN `--format github` runs against a fixture that fails THE SYSTEM SHALL print at least one line beginning `::error file=` and exit 1.
WHEN `--format` is given an unknown value THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 2.
verify: python scripts/validate_skill.py --root scripts/tests/fixtures/zones --rule zones --format github | grep -q '^::error file='

title: Add the blocking GitHub Actions workflow
acceptance: WHEN the workflow file is parsed by GitHub THE SYSTEM SHALL define exactly one job that runs `python -m compileall -q scripts`, `python -m json.tool scripts/validator-config.json`, `python scripts/validate_skill.py --self-test` and `python scripts/validate_skill.py --format github`, in that order.
WHEN either action is referenced THE SYSTEM SHALL name it by a 40-character commit SHA, never by a tag or a branch.
WHEN the workflow declares permissions THE SYSTEM SHALL grant `contents: read` and nothing else.
WHEN a pull request is opened or a commit lands on `main` THE SYSTEM SHALL be the complete trigger set, with no other event listed.
WHEN the job exceeds five minutes THE SYSTEM SHALL be cancelled by its own `timeout-minutes`.

title: Add the pre-commit hook and close the full gate
acceptance: WHEN `sh .githooks/pre-commit` runs on a clean tree THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0.
WHEN the hook runs against a tree whose validator reports a finding THE SYSTEM SHALL exit non-zero with the reason on one line, so the commit is aborted.
WHEN `git config core.hooksPath` is read after this task THE SYSTEM SHALL return `.githooks`.
WHEN the hook is read THE SYSTEM SHALL contain no reference to `python3`, which resolves to the Windows Store stub rather than an interpreter on the maintainer's machine.

WHEN the whole gate runs — compile, config parse, self-test, full run, JSON parse, hook, unknown-flag exit code, and a diff of the four upstream documents against HEAD — THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 on every line.
verify: git diff --quiet HEAD -- SKILL.md README.md LICENSE references
